name: mcp-context-manager
onCreateCommand:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
DOCKER_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/docker"
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) DOCKER_ARCH=x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) DOCKER_ARCH=aarch64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ ! -x "$DOCKER_BIN" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
  DOCKER_VERSION=27.4.0
  curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 20 "https://download.docker.com/linux/static/stable/$DOCKER_ARCH/docker-$DOCKER_VERSION.tgz" -o /tmp/docker.tgz
  mkdir -p /tmp/docker_extract
  tar -xzf /tmp/docker.tgz -C /tmp/docker_extract --strip-components=1
  mv /tmp/docker_extract/docker "$DOCKER_BIN"
  chmod +x "$DOCKER_BIN"
  rm -rf /tmp/docker.tgz /tmp/docker_extract
else
  echo "docker already present: $DOCKER_BIN"
fi
COMPOSE_VERSION=2.40.0
COMPOSE_BIN_DIR="$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins"
COMPOSE_BIN="$COMPOSE_BIN_DIR/docker-compose"
if [ ! -x "$COMPOSE_BIN" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$COMPOSE_BIN_DIR"
  curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 20 "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v${COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-linux-${DOCKER_ARCH}" -o "$COMPOSE_BIN"
  chmod +x "$COMPOSE_BIN"
fi
if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ]; then
  DOCKER_SOCK_GID="$(stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock)"
  if ! getent group "$DOCKER_SOCK_GID" >/dev/null; then
    sudo groupadd --gid "$DOCKER_SOCK_GID" docker-host
  fi
  DOCKER_SOCK_GROUP="$(getent group "$DOCKER_SOCK_GID" | cut -d: -f1)"
  sudo usermod -aG "$DOCKER_SOCK_GROUP" "$USER"
  export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock
  sudo "$DOCKER_BIN" version >/tmp/docker-version.txt || true
else
  echo "docker socket not available at /var/run/docker.sock"
fi'
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake cargo rustc python3-dev && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && python -m pip install --user --no-compile -e ".[dev]" --timeout 120 --retries 5 --progress-bar off'
